text:
sara: Hey folks — pushed a small fix that resolves the canary conflict in the PR. Addressed comments about null handling, split the big e2e into two smaller tests, and added a fixture for temp dirs. PTAL when you have a moment. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/...

adam: thanks — quick Q: did you run the flaky-tests suite? I saw a local failure yesterday.

sara: Yes, ran full flaky-tests locally and on CI. The failure was from a shared tmp dir race; added `tmp_path` fixture and made file writes atomic. CI passed on my fork before I pushed the commit here. Snippet:

```python
@pytest.fixture
def tmp_dir(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / "isolated"
    p.mkdir()
    yield p
```

li: LGTM overall. one tiny nit: async fn name doesn't match callers — can you rename `mk_tmp` -> `create_tmp_dir`?

sara: done, pushed rename and rebased onto main to resolve the merge conflict that would have blocked the canary. I'm requesting one more approval so we can merge and queue for canary tomorrow morning. @maria could you take a look when free? :pray:

maria: I'll take a look in ~30m.

devops-bot: Canary window opens 2024-05-15 09:00 UTC — reminder: avoid heavy DB migrations during this window.

maria: looks good to me, left a small comment about log level; will approve after that.

sara: thanks — switched the log to debug and squashed. PTAL again. Appreciate the quick eyes :thumbsup:
